name: Dyess AFB
description: Home of the 7th Bomb Wing and 317th Airlift Wing. Dyess AFB operates B-1B Lancer and C-130J Super Hercules aircraft, supporting global strike and mobility missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dyess Inn (325-696-2681) for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (325-696-4403) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 7 FSS, M&FRC, and official Dyess sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
